words: Hi Tom! How's it going? Haven't seen you for ages.
Not bad, thanks. Just a bit tired after work.
What have you been up to?
So, what have you been up to since the summer?
Let's meet for coffee and catch up.
Anna! Long time no see! How are the kids?
Any plans for the weekend, or are you just relaxing?
Close the window – it's freezing in here!
I'm really into hiking at the moment.
A picnic by the lake? Sounds great!
Really? I had no idea you could speak Italian!
You finished the marathon? Good for you!
You can't come to the party? That's a shame.
I know what you mean – Mondays are always hard.
By the way, have you seen the new Marvel film?
Anyway, I should get going – it was nice talking to you.
It's late, I really need to get going.
Hi, I'm Olena. Nice to meet you.
Bye, see you next week! Take care!
Say hi to your mum from me.
